مِحْقَنٌ A skin in which milk is collected; fresh milk being poured into it upon that which is curdled, or thick, or upon that which has been churned: (S:) or a skin into which milk is poured, [and in which it is kept,] that its butter may come forth. (K.) ―
-b2- And A funnel with which the milk is poured into the skin: (Az, K: *) or a funnel which is put into the mouth of a skin, into which one then pours wine, and water. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
